N1.reading_note: Gemini's reading of each video, not audited against the video. 'Key level' is not defined in any of the three; I read it as the overnight range extreme (the videos name pre-market and overnight highs) or the prior-day extreme, and test both as a grid dimension. The videos use 1m/2m/5m charts and often a half-size first entry plus scale-outs; this test uses 1-minute bars, one entry, fixed 2R (the OMEN research baseline).

N2.name: Opening-print rejection / reclaim

videos.TMybdhN1azw: 'Enter a short position when price wicks and rejects both a key level and the opening print.' Quote 04:36 'if you use levels and opening print, you can use that together to gauge where price is going to move next.'
videos.tMj4_K2eay0: 'once I saw that and then we got over the opening print I entered' (02:42); stop 'below the opening print and the recent swing low'.

N2.reading_note: 'Opening print' is read as the 09:30 ET open of the traded instrument's first RTH 1-minute bar. 'Reject' and 'reclaim' are two readings, both tested. The short mirror of 'reclaim' (loses the print after trading above it) is my symmetry assumption; the videos only show the long reclaim and the short reject.

N1_definition.traded_instrument: NQ. The other instrument (ES) is only used to judge divergence.

levels.ON: overnight low (ONL) / high (ONH) of each index
levels.PD: prior-session RTH low (PDL) / high (PDH) of each index

N1_definition.sweep: an index has swept the level when its 1-min low is strictly below its own level L (bullish) or its high strictly above its own level (bearish), at any bar from 09:30 up to and including the current bar.
N1_definition.bullish_trigger_at_bar_j: (a) exactly one index has swept its own low-level by bar j and the other has NOT (its running low since 09:30 is still >= its own level); (b) the sweeping index's first sweep was at most 15 bars before j (j - first_sweep <= 15, j >= first_sweep); (c) bar j of the sweeping index closes above its own level and closes green (close > open). Either index may be the sweeper. Bearish mirrors on highs: close under the level and red.
N1_definition.entry: NQ open at bar j+1 plus one tick against (long: +1 tick, short: -1 tick). First trigger of the day (bars 0..60). If a bullish and a bearish trigger fire on the same first bar, the day is skipped.

stop.candle: trigger bar's NQ extreme -/+ 1 tick (low for long, high for short), the 'one-candle stop' (w_Zn6QCkEB0)
stop.swing10: lowest low (highest high) of the last 10 NQ bars including bar j, -/+ 1 tick

N2_definition.OP: open of the 09:30 bar of the traded instrument

distances_as_share_of_OP.note: 0.005% = about 1 NQ point at 20,000; 0.05% = about 10 points; 0.125% = about 25 points. Shares, not points, so the ES replication scales.

N2_definition.reject: short: a 1-min bar j (1..60) whose high >= OP - tol, previous close < OP, closes < OP and red. Long mirror: low <= OP + tol, previous close > OP, closes > OP and green.
N2_definition.reclaim: long: a bar closes > OP and green after a previous close <= OP, and the lowest low from 09:30 to the previous bar is <= OP - dip. Short mirror: closes < OP and red after a previous close >= OP, and the highest high so far >= OP + dip.

key_level_filter.near: only days when PDH, PDL, ONH or ONL of NQ lies within 0.125% of OP (the 'rejects both a key level and the opening print' reading)

N2_definition.entry: next minute open +/- 1 tick against; first signal of the day (bars 1..60)
N2_definition.stop: extreme of the last 10 NQ bars including the signal bar, -/+ 1 tick (the videos put the stop beyond the recent swing)

es_replication: After the NQ run, the primary variant of each candidate is re-run once on ES (ES traded, NQ as the other index for N1) with the same definition and SPEC_ES. Declared now, report-only: it is a replication of the chosen variant, not a member of any family, and it cannot rescue a candidate that fails on NQ. If a candidate has no variant with n >= 30 there is no primary and no ES twin.
primary_variant_rule: per candidate: highest mean R among its 4 variants with n >= 30 (ties -> larger n), chosen on the fit window only.
std_bar: n >= 30, mean R >= +0.15, both halves > 0, day-level shuffle p < .05 (the variant's own p). A candidate clears only if its PRIMARY variant meets all four. Other variants are reported, never promoted after the fact. Halves split at the median aligned session date.

permutation.how: each draw maps every aligned session date to a different random date (one map for all variants); each trade is replayed on NQ's session at the mapped date with the same entry minute, side and stop as a share of price; if the mapped session lacks the entry minute, a random other session is used. p = (1 + draws with mean R >= real) / 2001. All 8 NQ variants are shuffled in ONE call so the draws are shared.
permutation.family_wise: per candidate: the max over its eligible (n >= 30) variants of the shuffled mean R per draw, compared with the primary's real mean R. Also reported across both candidates (max over all 8 eligible). Reported next to the std-bar p, not instead of it.
permutation.what_it_tests: whether these entry minutes, sides and stop sizes pay better on the real day than on a random day. It prices the day match, not the signal logic; the signal logic is tested by the real-data mean R and the halves.

if_a_candidate_clears: write a LOCKED confirm prereg for its primary variant in mentor-rule-candidates.md: fit result, frozen file hashes, the confirm data (NQ window B 2010-06-07..2019-09-25 is NOT on disk and its use needs Austin's 'window B ok'; ES window B is not on disk either), the std bar again, and the family-wise p.
if_none_clears: report the table, write no prereg. Update the canon ledger either way.
known_limits: 1-minute bars cannot show intrabar order; same-bar stop-wins is the conservative reading.
The videos trade 2m/5m charts with scale-outs and partial sizes; fixed 2R single entry is a simplification.
Two candidates, 8 variants on one window, on top of rounds 1-2 (19 variants) and earlier t-series: the family-wise p covers only the choice inside this round.
The fit window is already mined by many other tests and cannot confirm anything on its own.
